INSTAGRAM PUTS NEW LIMITS ON UNDISCLOSED AI PROFILES
articles.summary: Instagram is renaming its “AI creator” label to “AI-generated profile” to make it clearer when an account features a fully AI-generated person. It will also limit recommendations for unlabeled AI profiles, while creators who proactively disclose their AI identity won't see a reach penalty. The change targets transparency around AI personas, not creators who use AI tools in their content workflow.

articles.title: MUSIC LICENSING CLAIMS ARE COMING FOR MARKETERS
articles.summary: Music licensing claims are becoming a growing risk as brands and influencers use copyrighted content without proper clearance. Old social posts can also create exposure when licensing records are missing. Brands need to audit existing content and ensure influencer agreements cover licensing responsibilities.

articles.title: ADD G2 BADGES TO RETARGETING AD CAMPAIGNS
articles.summary: Use G2 badges in retargeting ads to give hesitant buyers an extra push. The familiar design builds recognition, while third-party validation can reduce the perceived risk of choosing your product. Pair the badge with a product benefit, category, or testimonial so it supports the ad rather than carrying it alone.

articles.title: WHAT MAKES A GOOD LISTICLE?
articles.summary: Freshness is the strongest ranking signal for listicles, so keep dates recent and easy for search engines to interpret. Explicit list counts also tend to perform better, with larger numbers often ranking higher. By contrast, word count, images, author bios, schema markup, and extra headings don't reliably improve rankings. Self-promotional listicles can still perform well, but putting your own product first doesn't appear to drive that growth.

articles.title: MYOG.SOCIAL
articles.summary: MyOG.social is an Open Graph checker and branded social card generator. The website offers a free URL checker to spot issues, and the paid tool automatically fixes broken social cards via a one-tag implementation.

articles.title: OPENAI LOOKS TO STREAMLINE CHATGPT AD CAMPAIGN CREATION
articles.summary: OpenAI is making it faster to launch ChatGPT ad campaigns with a redesigned onboarding flow that can build a campaign in under 60 seconds. Users can enter their website, and AI will analyze their business, suggest relevant ChatGPT user journeys, and generate ad creative and copy. OpenAI is also offering new advertisers $500 in matching ad credits.

articles.title: GOOGLE SHOPPING TAB LETS USERS FILTER PRODUCTS BY TRUSTED REVIEW SITES
articles.summary: Google is testing a new mobile Shopping filter that lets users narrow product results by review source. The “Top Reviewed in 2026” filter includes sites such as YouTube and Reddit, making it easier for shoppers to prioritize reviews from sources they trust.

articles.title: NO AI, NO UPLOADS, NO ADS: DIVINE'S CEO SAYS FRICTION COULD SAVE SOCIAL MEDIA
articles.summary: Divine, the app reviving Vine, bans AI content and requires videos to be filmed and verified live on-device. With no ads or algorithmic feed, it's betting that authenticity and familiar faces will matter more as AI floods social media with content.

articles.title: THE NEXT ERA OF MARKETING MAY BE A LOT SMALLER THAN YOU THINK
articles.summary: Marketing is moving away from mass reach and toward smaller, high-trust audiences. Brands like Urban Outfitters and Tracksuit are prioritizing participation and niche creators over follower counts, while Charli XCX is building intimate fan experiences before going mass. Deep audience relationships are becoming more valuable than sheer scale.

articles.title: META IS PUTTING HARD LIMITS ON FACEBOOK AND INSTAGRAM AFTER $17 BILLION SETTLEMENT
articles.summary: Instagram and Facebook will default minors to 2 hours of daily use, with overnight access blocked and school-hour notifications muted.

articles.title: SMALL UX PROBLEMS HARM TRUST
articles.summary: A broken link or clunky form can shape how users see a company.
